hypotheses.F1_fisher_sketch_is_stable: Independent 16-sample Fisher sketches have median mode-impact correlation at least 0.80 and median top-16 recall at least 0.50 on both corpora.
hypotheses.F2_fisher_route_has_larger_behavioral_ef: The median exact native KL of the Fisher-selected route is at least 1.25 times the local-score oracle on both corpora.
hypotheses.F3_local_route_has_larger_query_effect: The median absolute direct query effect of the local-score oracle is at least 1.25 times the Fisher route on both corpora.
hypotheses.F4_local_and_fisher_supports_differ: Median top-16 support overlap between local and Fisher oracles is at most 0.50 on both corpora.
hypotheses.F5_hierarchy_is_closer_to_local_target: The hierarchical route's finite Fisher fidelity is higher to the local-score oracle effect than to the Fisher-oracle effect on both corpora.
hypotheses.F6_fisher_ranking_predicts_finite_single: For local-contribution-matched pairs, Fisher-top modes have at least twice the median exact KL and win at least 75% of pairs on both corpora.
